assertion_audit.failure_condition: Restore the reason-first clause or omit/truncate next_action: the full fixed REMEDY no longer occurs in rendered output.
Append the command without removing its existing suffix: the full REMEDY occurs twice.
Discard the explanation, or consume its room at width 208: the independently fixed PlanReviewMissingError class is lost.
Omit or misformat the promotion counter: the expected formatted numeric cell disappears; supplied values test serialization, not count derivation.
Omit or misformat the oldest position: the independently specified @ cell and alignment disappear.
Bypass _clause_line truncation or append text after width allocation: the rendered line exceeds the chosen width.
Mutate the input refusal field while reordering the display: the saved pre-render value differs afterward.
The real PaneRowPath fixture changes refusal state away from queued: the fixed state expectation fails; this supplements the visibility guard rather than proving it.

assertion_independence: REMEDY and counters are supplied fixture inputs whose display is the behavior under test; restoring the reason-first renderer loses REMEDY and fails its output assertion, so these are not assertions that remain true under the targeted regression. The saved clause equality separately protects against input mutation.
